readout_other: Coma Recovery Scale-Revised; Glasgow Coma Scale; resting-state fNIRS functional connectivity; resting EEG power spectra
direction_notes: Single patient: CRS-R rose from 11 to 20 over 12 sessions, fNIRS functional connectivity increased and frontal delta and theta EEG power decreased; uncontrolled case report.
safety_notes: No change in vital parameters, no gross structural abnormalities on cranial CT, no adverse events reported.
